mapper.select: SELECT q.message_id,m.content,m.message_type,m.created_at FROM reply_questions q JOIN messages m ON m.id=q.message_id WHERE q.conversation_id=#{conversation} AND q.answered_at IS NULL AND m.message_type<>'order_info' AND NOT ORDER BY q.sequence

SELECT q.message_id,m.content,m.message_type,m.created_at FROM reply_run_messages r JOIN reply_questions q ON q.message_id=r.message_id JOIN messages m ON m.id=q.message_id WHERE r.run_id=#{run} AND m.message_type<>'order_info' ORDER BY q.sequence
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_runs SET context_at=#{now},conversation_revision=(SELECT revision FROM conversations WHERE id=#{conversation}) WHERE id=#{run}
mapper.select: SELECT m.created_at,q.sequence,r.message_id,r.single_question FROM agent_runs r JOIN messages m ON m.id=r.message_id JOIN reply_questions q ON q.message_id=m.id WHERE r.id=#{run}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reply_run_messages(run_id,message_id) SELECT #{run},message_id FROM reply_questions WHERE message_id=#{messageId} AND answered_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT q.message_id FROM reply_questions q JOIN messages m ON m.id=q.message_id WHERE q.conversation_id=#{conversation} AND q.answered_at IS NULL AND m.message_type<>'order_info' AND NOT AND q.sequence<=#{sequence} AND m.created_at>=#{start} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages sent WHERE sent.conversation_id=q.conversation_id AND sent.direction='outbound' AND sent.state='sent' AND sent.created_at>m.created_at AND sent.created_at<=#{createdAt}) ORDER BY q.sequence DESC LIMIT 8
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_runs SET single_question=TRUE WHERE id=#{run}
mapper.select: SELECT result FROM agent_runs WHERE id=#{run}

SELECT min(coalesce(r.batch_started_at,r.created_at)) AS first_at FROM agent_runs r JOIN messages m ON m.id=r.message_id JOIN jobs j ON j.reference_id=r.id AND j.kind='generate' WHERE m.conversation_id=#{conversation} AND r.state='queued' AND j.state='pending' AND j.attempts=0
mapper.update: UPDATE jobs SET state='done' WHERE kind='generate' AND state='pending' AND attempts=0 AND reference_id IN (SELECT r.id FROM agent_runs r JOIN messages m ON m.id=r.message_id WHERE m.conversation_id=#{conversation} AND r.state='queued')

UPDATE agent_runs SET state='superseded' WHERE state='queued' AND id IN (SELECT reference_id FROM jobs WHERE kind='generate' AND state='done') AND message_id IN (SELECT id FROM messages WHERE conversation_id=#{conversation})
UPDATE agent_runs SET batch_started_at=#{first} WHERE id=#{run}
UPDATE jobs SET available_at=#{due} WHERE kind='generate' AND reference_id=#{run}
mapper.select: SELECT message_id FROM reply_command_messages WHERE command_id=#{command}
SELECT count(*) FROM reply_questions WHERE message_id=#{id} AND conversation_id=#{conversation} AND answered_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE reply_questions SET answered_by=#{command},answered_at=#{timestamp} WHERE answered_at IS NULL AND message_id IN (SELECT message_id FROM reply_command_messages WHERE command_id=#{command})
